content: Anita Sharma emailed Pooja Bhatia regarding the upcoming expiration of her health policy (HP-4521) on 15/10/2026, presenting a standard renewal option ($1,080/year with unchanged deductible) and a low-premium option ($950/year with an increased deductible). Pooja replied asking for clarification on how the higher deductible impacts out-of-pocket costs for routine visits and inquired about the submission deadline for the renewal form.

action_items: Clarify impact of higher deductible on routine doctor visits
Provide deadline for submitting the renewal form
